digest.component_or_area: interfaces tier / write-op adapters (library, CLI, MCP)
propositions: Write-op parameters (force, reason, caused_by, ref, close_class) are hand-mirrored across three adapters (lib, CLI, MCP), creating silent drift risk with no mechanical detection.

A durable pytest conformance oracle executes a shared contract table (op, inputs, expected behavior) against all three adapters on fresh stores and fails on any behavioral divergence between adapters.
Runtime conditional rules (close_class-required for bug-close, reason-required for REASON_REQUIRED_CLASSES) are asserted behaviorally on every adapter rather than via shape generation.

MCP parameter gaps (reason/caused_by/force on transition/claim, ref on close) are encoded as strict-xfail rows citing scratchy-leprous-galago, keeping CI green until those gaps close and forcing marker removal on convergence.
The oracle reuses and extends tests/interfaces/adapters.py (Outcome, Adapter protocol, three implementations) to thread write-op inputs through each transport without building parallel drivers.
Adapter-bound internals (source, return_alias, _creation_channel, repo_root) are excluded from the contract to avoid false divergence signals.
